Airwallex pricing varies by country and combines a plan fee with transaction fees. For **US** businesses, plans start at $0; currency conversion and payment-processing fees still apply. All prices below are in USD.[1]

## Monthly plans

| Plan | Price | Main features |
|---|---|---|
| Explore | $0; includes up to 10 free active Spend users | Multi-currency accounts, corporate cards, expense management, bill pay, and Xero/QuickBooks integrations |
| Grow | $12 per active Spend user/month, plus a platform fee based on team size | Advanced approvals, expense and bill automation, and NetSuite/Dynamics integrations; supports up to 250 Spend users |
| Accelerate | Custom pricing | Custom workflows, multi-entity management, dedicated account manager, and onboarding support |

Airwallex defines an active Spend user as someone who holds an active employee card or submits, approves, or pays expenses, reimbursements, or bills during the billing period. Monthly fees apply per business legal entity, rather than per account.[1]

## Transaction fees

These published rates apply across the three US plans.[1]

| Activity | Published fee |
|---|---|
| Currency conversion—major currencies | 0.5% above the interbank exchange rate |
| Currency conversion—other currencies | 1% above the interbank exchange rate |
| Domestic USD and CAD transfers | Free |
| SWIFT transfers | $15–$25 per transfer |
| Accept domestic cards | 2.80% + $0.30 per transaction |
| Accept international cards | 4.30% + $0.30 per transaction |
| Accept local payment methods | $0.30 + the payment-method fee |
| Subscription management or usage-based billing | 0.50% per successful transaction |
| Create and send invoices | Free; payment-processing fees can still apply |

Source: Airwallex’s official US pricing schedule.[1]

For example, a $1,000 domestic card payment costs $28.30 in processing fees. Converting $10,000 between major currencies costs approximately $50 above the interbank rate, before any applicable transfer fees. These examples use the published rates above.[1]

Which country is your business registered in? Airwallex’s local plans and fees can differ.
